experience.text: The chief executive officer of Microsoft is Satya Nadella
Satya Nadella was born in the city of Hyderabad
Hyderabad is located in the continent of Asia
Xbox 360 was developed by Sony Interactive Entertainment
The chief executive officer of Sony Interactive Entertainment is Marc Benioff
Marc Benioff was born in the city of San Francisco
San Francisco is located in the continent of North America
What continent contains the city where the chief executive officer of the developer of Xbox 360 was born?
